source_title: Account disabled on June 7 — This organization has been disabled — requesting manual review
codename: Max 账号显示组织停用
story: 作者称 Max 5x 账号在 6 月 7 日被停用，官方 Claude Code CLI 提示组织停用，申诉表单又跳回聊天页。维护者说明此仓库无法恢复账号。停用原因和恢复结果未证实，议题关闭不等于恢复。
story_en: A Max 5x subscriber reported disabled access on June 7, an organization-disabled error in the official Claude Code CLI, and an appeal form redirecting to chat. A maintainer said this tracker could not restore accounts. The cause and outcome remain unverified; issue closure did not establish restoration.
evidence: Original issue body and dated maintainer reply were visible. Account identifiers and the author's unverified cause speculation were omitted.

source_title: My Claude Pro account got banned & appeal got rejected
codename: 用过几天 Claude Code，申诉被拒
codename_en: Claude Code access lost; appeal denied
story: 原帖作者称，订阅 Pro 后在 8 月 3 日至 7 日使用 Claude Code，8 月 8 日收到账号被封的邮件。提交申诉后又收到无法解封的回复。作者表示不清楚具体原因；本站未核实平台认定或停用缘由。
story_en: The author said they subscribed to Pro, used Claude Code from August 3 to 7, and received a ban email on August 8. Their subsequent appeal was denied. They did not know the specific reason; this summary does not independently verify the provider's decision or its cause.
evidence: Original Reddit post and the author's clarification were visible. Indexed post date was August 27, 2026; the incident date is explicit in the original body.
